entry.direct: A is used directly as the selected native value

initialization: stores selected value in local $58 and clears local $22/$24/$26/$28

projection.scale_input: Y is written twice to the Mode 7 matrix-B register for each nonzero coefficient
projection.outputs: hardware multiplication results are stored as signed-magnitude-like pairs $23/$24 and $27/$28; comparison of local $58-$0010 with $0020 controls omission/negation

limitations: The local pairs are not named velocity, displacement, or screen coordinates without caller/runtime validation.
Mode 7 multiplication proves arithmetic construction, not a browser-unit scale.
The eight selector values are raw native control values and are not assigned human direction labels.
